steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary instead of recreating or searching for an event.
Enable event scheduling as required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the Recreate Order dialog from the event settings menu.
Confirm the Recreate Order pop-up opened.
Tick scheduling while leaving the date and time fields empty.
Attempt to create the order with scheduling enabled but no schedule selected.
